SELECT 
    ai.*, 
    ar.category_id,
    (
        SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(aa ORDER BY aa.performed_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM public.alert_actions aa
        WHERE aa.alert_instance_id = ai.id
    ) AS actions,
    ar.ui_display_config,
    COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_records 
FROM 
    public.alert_instances ai
INNER JOIN public.alert_rules ar ON ai.rule_id = ar.id
WHERE 
    (
        $1 IS NULL 
        OR ai.status ILIKE $1
    )
    AND (
        $2 IS NULL 
        OR ai.priority ILIKE $2
    )
ORDER BY 
    ai.created_at DESC
LIMIT $3
OFFSET ($4 - 1) * $3;

SELECT ai.id as alert_instance_id, nc.slug as notification_category_slug, *
FROM public.alert_instances ai
INNER JOIN public.alert_rules ar ON ai.rule_id = ar.id
INNER JOIN public.alert_categories ac ON ar.category_id = ac.id
LEFT JOIN public.notification_categories nc ON ac.notification_category_slug = nc.slug
INNER JOIN public.users u ON ai.patient_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN public.communication_templates ct ON ar.email_template_id = ct.id
WHERE ai.id = ANY($1);

SELECT aa.*, ai.title, ai.summary, ai.notes
FROM
    public.alert_actions aa
INNER JOIN public.alert_instances ai ON aa.alert_instance_id = ai.id
ORDER BY
    performed_at DESC
LIMIT $1
OFFSET $2;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'PENDING') AS total_alertas_activas,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'CRITICAL') AS alertas_criticas,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'HIGH') AS alertas_alta_prioridad,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'MEDIUM') AS alertas_media_prioridad
FROM public.alert_instances
WHERE status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'ACTION_TAKEN', 'IGNORED', 'SUPPRESSED', 'SNOOZED');
